posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body: I'm looking for a battle system like the script Sapphire Action System IV for VX Ace but with a party of three and in RPG MZ. I want to make it where interacting with the enemies (Whether you attack them, get hit, or just touch them) on the map will lead you to a battle screen like with turn-based battles. In the battle screen, I want two rows for both you and your enemies (With the back rows being at the top and bottom of the screen).  In battle, you can move your main character, like on the map, and attack. There would be two other party members (At the bottom) that can be controlled with the shoulder buttons (If on a controller). Your allies control like turn-based with their corresponding buttons bringing up their commands. Each party member would have a gauge. To use magic the gauge must be full. With your back-row allies, you can defend, or attack which slows your gauge, while wait is faster but will leave you more vulnerable to physical attacks. Any time you're choosing commands I want everything in the battle to freeze so you don't have to worry about what your leader is doing. Those in the back row use ranged weapons which do less damage. I want one ally who uses magic staffs, rods, and the other a bow and arrow. Your leader would also have a ranged attack that does less damage. I want it to be where you can't move into the enemies' back row until their whole front row is defeated (Then you can use a close-range weapon for more damage). If your leader dies, the enemies will still attack with only ranged attacks and spells until he is resurrected. On the map screen is where I want it to be like Sapphire Action System IV. I want it so that your allies' gauges in battle will be full if you land an attack first, somewhere in the middle if you just touch, and empty if the enemy lands a hit first. When in the battle screen you start by choosing what you're going to do with your back-row allies before you can control the leader. If you landed a hit on the map you can cast spells right away. I want it to be where items can be used at any time but have a cool-down period that freezes the gauge. I'd also like a block and dodge ability for the leader, if possible.  The enemies I want to be regular character sprites instead of the normal battlers.
